overview_description.description:
ROBA - where anyone can create robots that work, learn, and generate value - without asking for permission.

Our vision:
A world where robotics innovation isn’t locked in corporate silos but shared openly in a collaborative ecosystem - powering classrooms, startups, and industries alike.

Mission:
Make robotics development accessible, collaborative, and scalable by providing the default hub for assets, tools, and talent.

about_short_description.short_description: ROBA is an open robotics platform enabling anyone to build, train, and monetize robots on-chain.

product.name: ROBA Creator Hub
product.description: A robotics development platform for creating, sharing, versioning, discovering, and monetizing models, algorithms, datasets, simulation worlds, and evaluation packs.

product.name: Roba Studio
product.description: A robotics development environment intended to combine simulation, AI frameworks, robot-building tools, and deployment management, including a planned no-code builder.

product.name: ROBA Simulation Environment
product.description: A cloud-first, browser-accessible environment for simulating and testing robotics systems using reusable templates and workflows.

product.name: ROBA Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace for buying, selling, licensing, and monetizing robotics assets such as models, algorithms, datasets, code, and simulation content.

product.name: ROBA Challenge System
product.description: A structured robotics competition and evaluation service in which participants submit solutions against benchmarks for rankings, reputation, and token-based rewards.

product.name: RobotRunTime
product.description: A lightweight robot operating system designed to provide efficient, real-time runtime capabilities for deploying robotics software.
